scientific_integrity: Universal claims are backed by explicit deformation and cellular representation proofs; finite checker corroborates examples without certifying infinity.
scientific_limitations: Equal-length arms and two ordered particles only; the rational splitting need not split integrally. Closely related nonequivariant persistent graph models are previously known. An unindexed equivalent equivariant formula remains possible.
title: Joint branch-permutation and particle-exchange persistence on equilateral metric stars
